Author: AlmondCookie
Name: AlmondChatTranslated
Changelog:
1.1.0：新增中文发话翻译（支持免 /tr 在勾选频道直接打中文自动译为目标语言直发、句首 ! 跳过翻译发原文，以及 /tr /trp /trs /tra /trsh /trfc /trr 指令与 /ok 预览双模式）；内置 FF14 中→日/英术语库与 0ms 高频短语直出；优化直连绕过系统代理、自定义模型兼容与并发熔断稳定性。

1.1.0: Added outgoing FFXIV chat translation (command-free auto-send per channel with '!' raw bypass, plus /tr commands and Direct / Preview modes), built-in FFXIV terminology & 0ms instant phrases, system-proxy bypass, custom model support, and burst-safe circuit breaker.
Punchline: DeepSeek 驱动的轻量实时聊天翻译 · Fast DeepSeek In-Game Chat Translator
Description:
AlmondChatTranslated 基于 kelvin124124/ChatTranslated 继续开发，专为 DeepSeek API 深度优化：零外部语言检测延迟、极速并发直连与上下文缓存、中文发话秒翻（支持免 /tr 频道自动直发与 /tr 指令双模式，内置 FF14 中日英术语优化）与招募板右键翻译。

Continued development of ChatTranslated powered exclusively by DeepSeek API with zero-network language pre-filtering, fast direct connection, outgoing FFXIV terminology translation (command-free auto-send + /tr commands), and Party Finder translation.

/act 打开主面板 | /tr 发话翻译 | /tr auto 免指令直发开关
